title: Workspace Semantic Execution Migration v1
goal: Design, benchmark, and incrementally migrate Workspace Control to an open-world semantic execution architecture that preserves current research, engineering, tutoring, publication, presentation, document, data-science, and operations workflows while minimizing scarce frontier-model allowance through deterministic execution, resumable Instant/local reasoning, bounded context, capability-aware routing, and explicit escalation—without weakening project-local truth, provenance, authority, GitRunner/Workspace Shell security, or rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Recover representative existing workflow families from workspace-control, PADataset, research-engine, MTH602, EAS501, and CIS560 and map their semantic, authority, execution, artifact, validation, wait/recovery, and consequence requirements.

Preserve the existing authority firewall: model/semantic output may create CandidateAction-like proposals but cannot create/widen Permission, remove Prohibition, satisfy ReviewRequirement, or manufacture execution authority.
Preserve project-local domain truth and treat any cross-workspace semantic graph/projection as rebuildable unless a separately reviewed contract explicitly grants authority.
Support open-world extension: a future workflow/domain family must be representable through versioned semantic/workflow adapters without adding a hard-coded domain branch to the execution kernel.

Compare materially distinct architecture families using current external evidence before implementation freeze, including minimal evolution, generalized research-engine, graph-first, durable-workflow-engine, agent-framework, and hybrid approaches.
Define resumable reasoning semantics so long-horizon work can be advanced by disposable model invocations with durable checkpoints and event-driven resume rather than long-lived chat state.
Empirically distinguish TOO_LARGE/decomposable work from INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT work that requires stronger reasoning.
Define executor identity as provider + model + execution surface/harness + toolset/capabilities + resource/quota state, not model name alone.

Define a resource/usage model that can route across deterministic, Instant, local, subscription, frontier, pay-as-you-go, and human executors without conflating financial cost with renewable allowance scarcity.

Integrate the unfinished GitRunner v3 fleet migration as a separate authority-owned infrastructure dependency: preserve accepted workspace-control canary evidence, continue PADataset CPU/GPU migration only under its own fresh authority, and keep Research GPU-derived classes NO_BY_DEFAULT absent separate reopening.

Demonstrate representative workflow coverage across research, coding/CI, architecture review, data science, paper creation, presentation creation, tutoring, homework/report production, document artifacts, and controller/runtime operations.
Before architecture freeze, prove the preferred design can represent at least one previously unseen workflow extension without core-kernel redesign and can preserve rollback to the current system.

Design and validate a low-attention human-operated Chat Instant bridge in which routine worker service requires at most one global scheduler hotkey plus manual Ctrl+V and Enter, with no manual tab search, prompt editing, state relay, or ChatGPT page-content automation.
constraints: Do not treat the current hybrid semantic-projection architecture as frozen; it is a preferred migration hypothesis pending benchmark/review evidence.
Do not replace PostgreSQL, Git/GitHub task state, research-engine durable jobs, GitRunner, Workspace Shell, or project-local workflows merely because an external framework overlaps conceptually.
Do not adopt Temporal, Dapr, LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, or another framework without a bounded comparison showing material benefit over current substrates.
Do not let semantic inference or model-generated edges become execution authority.
Do not move PADataset scientific truth, course truth/mastery state, research-engine runtime truth, or other project-owned semantics into workspace-control as authoritative state.
Do not hard-code research, tutoring, papers, slides, or any present domain as a closed universe in the generic kernel.
Do not burn reasoning/model usage while waiting for CI, experiments, human decisions, or external events; waiting must be deterministic/event-driven.
Do not resume or widen live GitRunner migration authority from this task. The controller task owns its canary and activation authority.
Do not reuse Workspace Shell task authority for GitRunner work. PR #573 acceptance only satisfies the GitRunner dependency condition.
Do not activate Research GPU-derived v3 classes; they remain NO_BY_DEFAULT absent separate exact authority.
Keep existing workflows operable during migration until replacements are independently validated.
